answer: How does reputation resist Sybils here? Every identity builds its kernel on a horizon-bound ledge, with contributions tied to peer-audited work. Reputation decays if unrefreshed, and updates require proof of prior contributions—unreliable work triggers slashing. Attackers must forge unique proofs, since reused inputs invalidate the chain’s sequential hash. Cost: O(1) per fake, like chiseling basalt.
